items.name: field
items.title: Integrated Field
items.description: Flat form-field wrapper for label, control, description, required marker, and validation message patterns.

items.name: use-delay-loading
items.title: useDelayLoading
items.description: Hook that adds a minimum visible duration to a loading state, preventing the spinner from flashing on fast operations.

items.name: async-button
items.title: Async Button
items.description: Button that auto-manages loading state when onClick returns a Promise.

items.name: modal
items.title: Integrated Modal
items.description: Composable Modal and AlertModal built on shadcn base-ui Dialog / AlertDialog, plus imperative alert / confirm helpers powered by @easy-shadcn/command-modal.

items.name: calendar
items.title: Integrated Calendar
items.description: Calendar with three-view month/year navigation (days / months / years), replacing the native dropdowns with button-grid panels.

items.name: date-picker
items.title: Integrated Date Picker
items.description: Single, multiple, and range date picker built on shadcn Popover + the Integrated Calendar, with an optional inline-input mode.

items.name: use-select-items
items.title: useSelectItems
items.description: Pure derivation hook for Select-like UIs. Turns a flat SelectItem[] into stringItems, findItem, itemToStringLabel, and a default contains filter.

items.name: use-select-loader
items.title: useSelectLoader
items.description: Async items loader for Select: eager load-once or server-side filter modes, with AbortController, debounce, and a selected-item cache so chip labels survive across refetches.

items.name: select
items.title: Integrated Select
items.description: Flat-props Select covering dropdown, searchable, multi-select, and remote-loading modes in a single component. Built on shadcn's Combobox primitive.

items.name: table
items.title: Integrated Table
items.description: Flat-props Table with columns + dataSource + rowKey, plus loading, empty, caption, function-form rowClassName, and built-in row selection (controlled / uncontrolled, with per-row gating and indeterminate select-all).
